{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Fine merino sweater, softly fitted, V-neck, hip-length, powder blue (#9DB8D3), merino wool
Midi skirt, gentle A-line, falling just below the knee, deep navy (#1F2D4A), wool crepe
Single-breasted jacket, straight cut, hip-length, slate grey (#5A6475), textured wool tweed
Sheer tights, 20 denier, dark navy (#26314D), nylon-elastane knit
Coat, straight cut, knee-length, burgundy (#6B2D3C), brushed wool
Ankle boots, low block heel of about 5 cm, almond toe, ink black-blue (#2A2F3A), smooth leather
Small crossbody bag, structured, burgundy (#6B2D3C), grained leather
Drop earrings, small, pearl-white (#F2EDE6) with silver-tone fittings, glass pearl

This outfit suits a neat evening at the theatre: a refined knit with a skirt and a textured jacket, finished with ankle boots. The powder blue near the face echoes her eye color and sits softly with her silver hair and cool, rosy skin. The navy skirt and slate jacket keep the lower part calm and elongated, and the A-line skirt with a straight jacket gives a balanced, easy shape. The burgundy coat and bag add warmth for a cool autumn evening, and the block heel is comfortable for sitting and for walking between the foyer and the seat."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2319,"output_tokens":1349},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
